hints.title: Prefix Divisor State
hints.text: Maintain the number of ways to achieve each possible running greatest common divisor after choosing elements from the first r rows.

hints.title: Divisor Contraction
hints.text: When transitioning to row r + 1, combine existing divisor states with each element of the new row using greatest common divisor arithmetic.

hints.title: Coprime Target
hints.text: After iterating through all matrix rows, the answer is the total combination count accumulated under divisor state 1 modulo 10^9+7.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: C: number of columns per row
D: number of distinct possible divisor states
complexity.notes: State compression DP over distinct greatest common divisors.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force testing all C^R combinations is impossible for large dimensions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(D) memory bounded by divisors of matrix values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash table DP keyed on running gcd across matrix rows.
